description: Report how many screenshots the configured API key has used this month, the plan's monthly limit, how many are left and when the quota resets. Use it before a large batch of captures or when a capture fails with a quota error. This check itself costs 1 screenshot of the quota, so do not call it routinely.
name: get_usage

limit.description: Screenshots included per period on this plan.

quota_restart_date.description: `quotaRestartDate` exactly as the API reports it.

resets_on.description: Date (UTC) the monthly quota next resets.

used.description: Screenshots used in the current period.

title: Get usage
